text:
emily: Heads-up  change window at 02:00 PT today. Deploying inference-service v10.4.0. Plan: enable feature flag `ff_fast_completion_v3` in guarded ramp (7% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%) with 6m holds. We'll pin model routing to prod-q2 for 90m as a precaution. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v10.4.0. Any blockers?

deploy-bot: Scheduled start: 2024-12-08T02:00:00PT. Canary batch = 7 instances. Ramp plan: 7% @t+2m, 30% @t+8m, 60% @t+18m, 100% @t+30m. Auto-pause gates: p99 > 210ms for 4m OR 5xx > 0.3% for 4m OR token-cost-per-minute delta > +15% sustained for 10m. Will post step health.

rajesh: Adding: billing watch requested. That cost gate is new; billing team pls ACK. Also request that we keep a comparison trace between quantized (q8) and baseline prod-q1 on the canaries.

sara: On docs/runbook: bump trace sampling to 1500/s for 20m after each step. Canary will initially use q8-quantized binary; if we see cost or quality regressions we fallback to prod-q1. Confirming we have the pin fallback ready.

billing: ACK. We'll monitor token-cost and emit PD if delta >12% for 8m. We'll post cost-snapshot links in this thread if alert fires.

deploy-bot: Quick rollback (operator):
```
# disable feature and pin routing for safety
redwoodctl ff set ff_fast_completion_v3 0 --reason "rollback: cost gate triggered"
redwoodctl routing pin model prod-q2 --duration 90m
# helper: unpin early if verified fix
redwoodctl routing unpin model --confirm --trace $TRACE_ID
```

emily: Added these snippets to the runbook and release notes. Who has deploy token? @ops-oncall please confirm.

ops-oncall: I have deploy token and will be watching infra. Tag me to execute rollback if needed.

deploy-bot: Canary at 7% stable @t+4m. Proceeding to 30% @t+8m.

sara: Observability: token-cost delta at t+12m is +9% (expected) and quality hold looks good. Increasing sampling.

rajesh: p95 saw a short spike at t+14m, recovered by t+16m. No sustained latency issue.

deploy-bot: Reached 60% @t+19m. Monitoring hold window.

billing: Alert: token-cost delta breached threshold. Cost delta = +16% averaged over 12m. Triggering cost gate pause.

deploy-bot: Automated pause triggered at t+22m due to token-cost-per-minute delta > +15% for 10m. Ramp paused at 60%.

sara: Investigating: quantized q8 path is increasing small-response QPS (more short requests), which raised per-minute token throughput and amplified billing. Model latency and errors unchanged. This looks like behavioral amplification rather than a service error.

rajesh: Given cost gate and product impact, recommendation = pause and rollback FF to 0, pin routing for 90m, collect cost/traces, then plan A/B comparing q4 vs q8 with batching tweaks.

emily: Agreed. Execute rollback now. We'll schedule a follow-up dry-run with billing present.

deploy-bot: Executing rollback as operator.
```
redwoodctl ff set ff_fast_completion_v3 0 --reason "rollback: cost gate tripped"
redwoodctl routing pin model prod-q2 --duration 90m
```

billing: Cost alert acknowledged. Posting snapshot: https://billing.internal/snapshots/1749999998-costsnap (link). Will run post-mortem cost analysis.

sara: After rollback token-cost returned to baseline within 8m. Collecting traces and diffs for the post-run analysis.

rajesh: I'll compile SLO + cost report and open a ticket to test q4 quant vs q8 with reduced batching and measure token amplification.

ops-oncall: Infra healthy. No 5xx surge. We'll keep the pin until the safety window expires.

emily: Thanks team. Release notes updated with rollback rationale and next steps. We'll reschedule a controlled A/B with billing present. Closing active rollout; keep thread for follow-ups.
